## Design

### 2026-10-13 – For the keyboard fidget portion, I wanted this to be a big case with lots of details. Firstly, it's modeled after summoner's rift, so of course it gotta look like it. So, I decided to do mid lane, top

**2.32h**

For the keyboard fidget portion, I wanted this to be a big case with lots of details. Firstly, it's modeled after summoner's rift, so of course it gotta look like it. So, I decided to do mid lane, top lane, and bottom lane representations with keycaps, as well as adding elevated trees (using loft and different planes for different heights) on the exterior for an arena feel.
The first thing I did was to make sure I could actually install the cherry mx petal keys I've always wanted to use, so I made sure to extensively search up the measurements and figure out how to mount it (using two "lips" near the middle, one flexible to snap into place. hopefully it works). Then, I could add a layer 4mm above it that was wider (18.5mm square vs 14 mm square of the mounted piece) so when the button was unclicked, the inner workings wouldn't be seen.
I chose a larger size purely for it to be a container for the other 2 things I plan to make. If I run out of time, I will squish the size and keep only the keyboard fidget, but hopefully I can get a trophy at least out as well.

tomorrow! I will get the detailing of the rift out - not too much, just HLE logo, the players' symbols on the rift, perhaps some cool geometries? I want the main focus to be on the keys, so tomorrow I'll make the main middle key (figure out the crosses on the switches) with relatively simple embosses and text.

tldr: finished initial base for keyboard fidget including installation places for switches and mounts. Added details like trees and size dimensions.

### 2026-10-14 – added tolerances to some (to the ones I didn't, I'll file it down if it's too thick

**3.62h**

added tolerances to some (to the ones I didn't, I'll file it down if it's too thick
I added two keys, the long HLE key and the smaller orange key (that turned out to be large to fit the cherry mx).
I also edited the base holder to be more fitting to the keys, and I changed the colors of some of the parts (perhaps I will do a mix of glue for some inserts and hope for a good printer that can print multiple colors in 1 print). I hope I can get the pale gold color, but if not then I would prob choose white if only base colors available.
It took quite a while to get the dimensions of the orange (circle had to be distance of diagonal instead of regular side b/c circle), the cherry mx cross and whatnot (had to do bunch of restrictions in my sketches), and the LCK logo (specific angles, etc). I figured it out - today was just a work session, nothing too major.
Tomorrow, I plan to make the other 3 keys. One will be a clear nexus to showcase the cherry mx petal's pretty color, one will be a more complex clear keycap but crowned with upside down crown (or right side up idk yet), and one will be kind of a face of a chicken. Trust.
Also, I'm deciding to not do the other 2 charms unfortunately because it took me almost 6 hours to get this much done - I rather make this one thing super nice than have 3 eh ones. I'll have chances to make them in the future hopefully.

P.S I also started the nexus keycap b/c I was excited - SLA resin seems to not be too expensive and can work!!! I did a bunch of research on those + the type of switches I want (I put them in BOM today) and where to buy to fit budget so I add 0.5 hrs b/c I at least spent that much time doing the research and making sure the resin could work with my ideas lol

tldr: finished 2 keys + details + mounts, added some colors

### 2026-10-15 – Changed the height + color of the base at school because I decided to not make it a locker for other charms. Might change the height to be a bit thicker so embosses look better? That's the 0.1 extra h

**3.18h**

Changed the height + color of the base at school because I decided to not make it a locker for other charms. Might change the height to be a bit thicker so embosses look better? That's the 0.1 extra hrs I added.

Yeah um. The nexus takes so much time. Because it is technically quite irregular (though more regular than the red nexus), I tried to get it as close to the photo but eventually gave up - it looks quite good.
The heights of the nexus one gave me trouble - I initially wanted the switch stem to be in the crystal itself but had to make this mock base "nexus water" so it can actually function as a keycap. I also made it into two parts because of resin printing - cannot have hollow spaces and larger blocks of resin don't print well, so 2 parts that are both hollow + I hopefully can tightly assemble them.
I also realized that I messed up the sizing of the circle keycaps. First was the nexus border - it was too small, but then I realized that I set the diameter of the outer radius of keycaps to be hypotenuse of a square with 18.3mm sides, not the 15.8mm sides (technically 15.6 but I added 0.2mm as tolerance). So, to save some space and filament, I squished them down, including the orange one.
Tomorrow, I hope to finish the other two keycaps. Shouldn't be too difficult - other than the crown one needing interlocking parts, the chicken (Soori) one should just be embosses and engraves on PETG, which is easier than the crown one on resin. I also hope to just quickly make the other simple keycaps (maybe I will emboss/engrave a signature champ of each and their signature symbol + on the sixth regular one do the msi symbol or something). After all keycaps are done, I'll have to get the box engravings done. I want to engrave the worlds symbol on the bottom of the case, emboss HLE symbol, "beyond the challenge", but idk how much time I will have to actually do it, so I'm quite nervous (+ I need to coordinate with printers and stuff).

tldr: finished nexus keycap (irregular shape, took super long), fixed circle keycaps' sizing issues

### 2026-10-16 – In the 0.5 hrs not on lapse, I started the regular keycaps and adjusted the size of the HLE one (it was too thick - I realized I measured from the edge of the cross, not the middle, for one side not t

**5.63h**

In the 0.5 hrs not on lapse, I started the regular keycaps and adjusted the size of the HLE one (it was too thick - I realized I measured from the edge of the cross, not the middle, for one side not the other, so the square was asymmetric relative to the cross). This was in school, so no personal computer for lapse.

The rest (dang that's a long time) 5 hours, I finished the other keys. I should be writing my prompts, but I was super excited, so I finished the player keys with a slight curve in the center for hand feel, counted tolerances and thicknesses with the dip down, and special symbols for each player. I also finished the soori keycap which was harder than expected because of the sizing - looks not bad though right now. I also adjusted a bunch of tolerances for the keycap slots - the holes are now wider so the keycaps could slide easily. I'll have to double check them some time though.
Tomorrow or Sunday, I'll finish the crown keycap which will take more time as well as the HLE logo keycap. I also need to add embosses on the box itself (perhaps I'll do that later today so maybe another journal super late in the evening lol).

tldr: finished most keycaps except for 2, did all keycaps with lots of care for tolerances, hand feel, and special symbols.
